remarks: Spacious Three-Level Townhouse in Stamford's Desirable Cove Beach Area!  Welcome to this great 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse offering comfort, style, and convenience. The main level features hardwood floors, a bright and open living space, and access to your private deck and yard-ideal for relaxing or entertaining. The lower level provides excellent potential for additional living space, a home office, or extra storage.   Newer heat and a/c installed in 2023 and warranty will be transfer to the new owners. New driveway has just been done. Perfectly situated just half a mile from Cove Island Park, where you can enjoy tennis, volleyball, a playground, marina, and hockey rink. Conveniently located near beaches, parks, restaurants, shopping, and all that Stamford has to offer!
